items.title: Why Is Palantir (PLTR) In Focus After Thiel Turned To AI Power Assets?
items.summary: Peter Thiel, linked to Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR), is steering his hedge fund toward AI related electricity and power infrastructure instead of focusing mainly on chipmakers and software companies. The shift reframes AI growth as a question of energy supply and grid capacity rather than just processing power and data analytics.
